description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git ls-files --deduplicate' command under various scenarios. It sets up a git repository, performs commits and merges, and checks the output of the command with different flags.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test scenario with a description and associated commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command must fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
